basic_profile.bio: A Chicago native who has been lurking around Reddit since 2015. Fascinated by the intersection of comedy and controversy, I'm a big fan of irreverent humor and in-depth discussions. I work in IT, which gives me plenty of time to browse Reddit during the day. Outside of work, I'm either playing spikeball or watching Huskers games. I love exploring new hobbies, especially those that can be enjoyed outdoors. Single and living in the city, I enjoy the nightlife but am just as content with a quiet evening in. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings after work or on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a natural curiosity for tech, I have a strong foundation in IT and cybersecurity. My expertise has been honed over years of professional experience and self-driven learning, aided by countless online courses and certifications.
